tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'documentation/quality-gate'; $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Filter '*.md' -File); if ($files.Count -ne 9) { throw 'Expected nine specification and review files.' }; $links = 0; foreach ($file in $files) { $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName); if ($text -notmatch '2026-09-12' -or $text -notmatch '(?i)Status:' -or $text -notmatch 'Version:') { throw ('Missing specification metadata: ' + $file.Name) }; $headings = @([regex]::Matches($text, '(?m)^## .+$') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value.Trim() }); if (@($headings | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne $headings.Count) { throw ('Duplicate section heading: ' + $file.Name) }; foreach ($match in [regex]::Matches($text, '\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)')) { $target = $match.Groups[1].Value; if ($target -match '^(https?:|#)') { continue }; $path = ($target -split '#')[0]; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath ([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath([System.IO.Path]::Combine($file.DirectoryName, [Uri]::UnescapeDataString($path)))))) { throw ('Broken local link in ' + $file.Name + ': ' + $target) }; $links++ } }; $catalog = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $root '04-task-flow-coverage.md')); $ids = @([regex]::Matches($catalog, '(?m)^\| ((?:AUTH|CHAT|HIST|TOOL|IMG|LIB|MEM|SET|VOICE|ADMIN|PLATFORM)-\d{2}) \|') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }); if ($ids.Count -ne 60 -or @($ids | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 60) { throw 'Flow catalog count or uniqueness failed.' }; $detectors = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $root '05-evaluation-and-design-system.md')); foreach ($match in [regex]::Matches($catalog, 'DET-[A-Z]+-\d{2}')) { if (-not $detectors.Contains($match.Value)) { throw ('Undefined detector: ' + $match.Value) } }; $main = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) 'documentation/README.md')); if (-not $main.Contains('(quality-gate/README.md)')) { throw 'Main documentation link missing.' }; [ordered]@{ status='PASSED'; specificationFiles=$files.Count; checkedLocalLinks=$links; uniqueSeedFlows=$ids.Count; liveCoverageClaimed=$false; runtimeImplemented=$false } | ConvertTo-Json }

tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $browsers = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'Name = ''msedge.exe''' -OperationTimeoutSec 10 | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch '--type=' }); $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -in $browsers.ProcessId -and $_.LocalAddress -in @('127.0.0.1','::1') }); $observations = @($browsers | ForEach-Object { $browserProcess = $_; $port = [regex]::Match($browserProcess.CommandLine, '--remote-debugging-port(?:=|\s+)(\d+)'); [ordered]@{ processId = $browserProcess.ProcessId; remoteDebuggingPort = $(if ($port.Success) { [int]$port.Groups[1].Value } else { $null }); remoteDebuggingPipe = [bool]($browserProcess.CommandLine -match '--remote-debugging-pipe'); headless = [bool]($browserProcess.CommandLine -match '--headless'); explicitProfileDirectory = [bool]($browserProcess.CommandLine -match '--profile-directory'); loopbackListenerPorts = @($listeners | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -eq $browserProcess.ProcessId } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty LocalPort) } }); [ordered]@{ inspectedAt = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); edgeBrowserProcesses = $browsers.Count; processes = $observations; rawCommandLinesCaptured = $false; profileDataRead = $false; browserStateChanged = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 }

tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $browser = Get-Process -Id 57452 -ErrorAction Stop; if ($browser.ProcessName -ne 'msedge') { throw 'Unexpected browser process identity.' }; $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 9222 }); $unsafe = @($listeners | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -ne $browser.Id -or $_.LocalAddress -notin @('127.0.0.1','::1') }); if ($unsafe.Count) { if (@($unsafe | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -eq $browser.Id }).Count) { Stop-Process -Id $browser.Id -Force }; throw 'Debug listener is not exclusively the authorized Edge process on loopback.' }; $policies = @(); foreach ($scope in @('HKCU','HKLM')) { $path = $scope + ':\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge'; $value = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $path -Name RemoteDebuggingAllowed -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -ne $value) { $policies += [ordered]@{ scope=$scope; remoteDebuggingAllowed=$value.RemoteDebuggingAllowed } } }; $endpointAvailable = $false; $failure = $null; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version' -TimeoutSec 3 -MaximumRedirection 0; $version = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $endpointAvailable = [bool]($version.webSocketDebuggerUrl -match '^ws://(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost|\[::1\]):9222/devtools/browser/'); } catch { $failure = $_.Exception.GetType().Name }; [ordered]@{ status=$(if($endpointAvailable -and $listeners.Count){'ENDPOINT_AVAILABLE'}else{'DEBUG_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE'}); processId=$browser.Id; edgeVersion=$browser.MainModule.FileVersionInfo.ProductVersion; listenerCount=$listeners.Count; endpointAvailable=$endpointAvailable; connectionFailure=$failure; configuredPolicies=$policies; profile='Profile 5'; cloning=$false; automatedPageInteraction=$false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 }
